# The content has a title line and then each line is "Song Name by Artist".
note_content = "The Ghosts of Our Past by Mia Sullivan\nThe Fading Light of Memory by Violet Cascade\nPainted Skies by Hazel Winter\nThe Paradox of Our Love by Oceanic Odyssey\nThe Inescapable Gravity of Love by Zoe Mitchell\nBleeding Sun by Aria Sterling\nTrapped in a Daydream by Nova Harmony\nWaiting for the Morning Light by Grace Harrison\nVivid Scars by Lucas Grey\nHarmony of the Distant Stars by Lily Moon\nFleeting Touch by Mia Sullivan, Carter Knight\nBitter Haze by Marcus Lane\nSilent Sorrow by Aria Sterling\nThe Spiral of Unending Thoughts by Carter Knight"

# Split by newline, skip the first line (title)
lines = note_content.split('\n')
song_names = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    # Each line is "Song Name by Artist(s)"
    # Split on " by " and take the first part as the song name
    if ' by ' in line:
        song_name = line.split(' by ')[0].strip()
        song_names.append(song_name)
    else:
        # If no " by ", treat the whole line as song name
        song_names.append(line.strip())

print(song_names)

    parts = line.split(" by ")
    if len(parts) == 2:
        title = parts[0].strip()
        artists_str = parts[1].strip()
        # Split artists by comma
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(",")]
        songs.append({"title": title, "artists": artists})
    else:
        print("Could not parse:", line)

print(songs)
